_comment: Roster of monsters, reconciled against PixelLab by pipeline/sync.py — the MONSTER tag on PixelLab decides membership; this file just pins each monster's stable folder id, display name and animation renames ({exact PixelLab animation name: idle|walk|angry|attack|die}). Hand-tune names/renames freely; sync preserves them across runs. Entries whose pixellab_id loses its tag are dropped (and their folder pruned).

monsters.name: Emberwing
monsters.lore: No bigger than a lantern, it drifts on wings too gaudy for a dragon — then breathes fire that shames its size.

monsters.name: Mirewart
monsters.lore: Fattened on swamp-magic and far too clever. Novices laugh at it once, then learn to respect the slam.

monsters.name: Quillkin
monsters.lore: A grumpy ball of needles that would rather nap than fight. Corner it and the quills leave first, fast as arrows.

monsters.name: Fluffang
monsters.lore: Harmless-looking and quick to bolt, though the bite is real. A beginner's first honest mistake.

monsters.name: Palehusk
monsters.lore: Someone's failed experiment, wearing borrowed skin. It shambles after travellers on limbs that bend wrongly.

monsters.name: Grinmask
monsters.lore: A sliver of living dark behind a grinning mask. Slay it and the shadow is gone; the mask clatters down, still smiling.

monsters.name: Glowbone
monsters.lore: Its bones burn through split hide, lighting the woods it hunts. You see the glow long before the claws.

monsters.name: Palemaw
monsters.lore: A pale cave-dweller with a jaw built for bone. It bites once, hard, and seldom needs to bite twice.

monsters.name: Emberjaw
monsters.lore: Basks in cooling magma and bites with a mouthful of flame. Its hide stays warm for hours after it falls.

monsters.name: Rimeshard
monsters.lore: Black rock grown through with living ice. It tears crystal spears from the ground and swings them like clubs.

monsters.name: Puddling
monsters.lore: A wobbling drop of pond water with a face. Cornered it bursts; beaten, it spreads out and quietly steams away.

monsters.name: Magmashell
monsters.lore: Ancient, grumpy, and full of banked fire. The cracks in its shell glow brighter the angrier it gets.

monsters.name: Stumpling
monsters.lore: A stump that woke one spring. It hauls itself along on root-legs and lashes at anyone who treads on its moss.

monsters.name: Dewling
monsters.lore: A pale meadow blob that balances a dewdrop like a crown — and swings it at whatever wanders too close.

monsters.name: Mosscairn
monsters.lore: Moss-clad boulders bound by old earth-magic. It rips the ground open with one fist; the head topples first.

monsters.name: Slagling
monsters.lore: A crust of cooled stone with molten rage beneath. It flares white-hot when angered, then melts into slag.

monsters.name: Sprigling
monsters.lore: A green woodland blob armed with a splinter of oak. Cut it down and it scatters into smaller blobs.

monsters.name: Balefiend
monsters.lore: Elder kin of the eye-demons, wreathed in flame and swirling dark. Its slam is meant to crush, not to wound.

monsters.name: Ashfiend
monsters.lore: A thin horror with too many eyes and no patience. It strikes with its skull and falls to ash when finished.

monsters.name: Frostling
monsters.lore: A snow-packed blob with a frozen grin. It spits ice spikes, and melts to slush when its winter finally ends.

monsters.name: Briarknot
monsters.lore: The nest was left before the bramble grew around it. It keeps the eggs warm out of habit and there is nothing inside them.

monsters.name: Burrkin
monsters.lore: It catches on everything that passes and keeps a thread of it. None of it is worth anything and it will not put any of it down.

monsters.name: Huskling
monsters.lore: It fell from a tree nobody has found. Where it roots, the ground goes hard and the crops go quiet.

monsters.name: Tollkeeper
monsters.lore: The bridge is older than the town and the troll is older than the bridge. The toll has never once been coin.

monsters.name: Warmaul
monsters.lore: It fights for whoever pays in iron and eats whoever does not. The axe has a name; it will not say it.

monsters.name: Cragram
monsters.lore: It holds the high ledge against anything that climbs. The horns have broken shields, and the mountain has never won.

monsters.name: Carrionwing
monsters.lore: It circles the road for days and lands only when it is certain. It has never once been wrong.

monsters.name: Rimeling
monsters.lore: A splinter of the glacier that walks ahead of the cold. Where it stands, the frost arrives early.

monsters.name: Ashling
monsters.lore: Hatched in the cinder beds beneath the caldera. It will grow into a mouthful of flame; for now it only glows.

monsters.name: Shellet
monsters.lore: The first of the clutch to reach the water, and the only one. It has been careful ever since.

monsters.name: Deepmaul
monsters.lore: It has never seen the sun and hates it on principle. Anything with a torch gets the club first.

monsters.name: Fenfather
monsters.lore: The fen itself, when the fen stands up. Villages built on it are carried off when it turns.

monsters.name: Prismfather
monsters.lore: Light goes into it and comes out wrong. Miners follow the rainbows down and are found as rainbows themselves.

monsters.name: Broodmother
monsters.lore: Every spider in the dark is hers and every dark is a nursery. She does not hunt; she waits, and the dark brings supper.

monsters.name: Pebblemite
monsters.lore: It is a pebble until it isn't. Cairns are made of them, and cairns move at night.

monsters.name: Rimemite
monsters.lore: It bites once and the bite never thaws. Snow-walkers check their boots every night for good reason.

monsters.name: Glareling
monsters.lore: It watches for something bigger. What it sees, the something bigger sees too.

monsters.name: Hoodfang
monsters.lore: It sways so you will watch the hood. The bite comes from where you were not watching.

monsters.name: Wrapwarden
monsters.lore: Its name was carved off the tomb, so it went looking for it. It checks every face and none of them fit.

monsters.name: Stonegaze
monsters.lore: Meet its eyes and become a landmark. The roadside is lined with people who did, still pointing the way.

monsters.name: Inkling
monsters.lore: It has three hearts and holds a grudge in each. The ink is how it says goodbye.

monsters.name: Scaleblade
monsters.lore: Its people ruled the marsh before the marsh drowned them. It still patrols the borders of a country that is gone.

monsters.name: Moonrend
monsters.lore: It runs the ridge under every full moon and comes back fed. The village no longer asks what it ate.

monsters.name: Hexcrone
monsters.lore: She trades in wishes and collects in years. Every village has one story about her, and every story ends the same.

monsters.name: Marrowbolt
monsters.lore: It cannot see and does not miss. The arrows are older than the bow, and the bow is older than the wall.

monsters.name: Gravemaw
monsters.lore: It eats what the graves give up and waits for more. Its patience is only hunger, drawn out.

monsters.name: Cragtroll
monsters.lore: It sleeps as a hillside and wakes as a landslide. Travellers who camp on it are the reason it wakes.

monsters.name: Rootfather
monsters.lore: Older than the road that was cut around it. It has forgiven the axe once, and says so, and will not do it twice.

monsters.name: Pebblet
monsters.lore: A pebble that pinches. The beach is full of stones, and some of them are waiting.

monsters.name: Pyrelord
monsters.lore: The mountain's first king and its only one. Every eruption since has been his voice.

monsters.name: Snapshell
monsters.lore: The tide brings it up and forgets to take it back. It holds the beach with one great claw and never learned to let go.

monsters.name: Hollowplate
monsters.lore: The knight left long ago. The armor kept the vigil, and the fire that keeps it standing has forgotten whose it was.

monsters.name: Gnashjaw
monsters.lore: It gnaws boulders to keep its tusks short. When the grinding stops, something softer has wandered close.

monsters.name: Sorrel
monsters.lore: A farm horse that outlived its farm. It still waits at the gate each dusk for a hand that never comes.

monsters.name: Snowmane
monsters.lore: White as the morning it vanished from the king's stable. It allows no rider, but walks beside the lost.

monsters.name: Duskhoof
monsters.lore: A black horse that casts no shadow. It stamps, and the dark pools around its hooves like spilled ink.

monsters.name: Gnarloak
monsters.lore: Roots that dreamed of being a bear. It sleeps for whole seasons, and wakes furious at whatever an axe is.

monsters.name: Magmane
monsters.lore: A lion poured from the volcano's throat. Its obsidian mane cools black; its roar glows through the cracks.

monsters.name: Sporehorn
monsters.lore: The fungus steers the elk now. Its antlers bloom green in the dark, sowing spores wherever it grieves.

monsters.name: Tuskmaul
monsters.lore: The old bull of the brutes. Whole warbands have broken against shoulders wider than their shield-wall.

monsters.name: Nightmare
monsters.lore: It gallops where sleep is thin. Pale flames mark its passing, and by morning no one recalls their dreams.

monsters.name: Cragback
monsters.lore: A hillside that stood up. Moss and granite shift when it breathes, and climbers swear the mountain growled.

monsters.name: Gravecharger
monsters.lore: A war-mount that refused to fall with its rider. It still charges the enemy line, centuries after the war.

monsters.name: Bergclaw
monsters.lore: Carved by the glacier and jealous of it. Its frozen tusks crack shields the way spring cracks river ice.

monsters.name: Sunscale
monsters.lore: A cat armored in noon-light. Its golden scales drink the desert sun and pay it back in blinding flashes.

monsters.name: Rotjaw
monsters.lore: Too stubborn to stay buried. Its crooked jaw hangs loose, grinning at a joke told before it died.

monsters.name: Prismclaw
monsters.lore: A lynx grown through with crystal. Light bends wrong around it, and its tail-blade sings when it strikes.

monsters.name: Bogstalker
monsters.lore: Yellow eyes just above the waterline, algae drifting where it waits. The swamp's stillness is a hunting pose.

monsters.name: Mireglare
monsters.lore: Its stare bores through the fen-mist and burns. Hunters who meet those still eyes are found lit from within.

monsters.name: Cinderhowl
monsters.lore: A hound cracked open by its own fire. Embers sift from its seams, and its howl smells of burning.

monsters.name: Voltshell
monsters.lore: Storms nest in the crystals on its shell. It crosses a valley in a lifetime, thunder rolling in its wake.

monsters.name: Thornstag
monsters.lore: Corruption walking on too-long legs. Thorned vines drag from its antlers, and flowers die where it browses.

monsters.name: Voidmaw
monsters.lore: It has no face, only appetite. The ringed mouth opens wider than reason, and the light goes in first.

monsters.name: Moonpelt
monsters.lore: A wolf the moon keeps. Its silver fur holds the crescent's mark, and its paws never quite touch the frost.

monsters.name: Stormcrown
monsters.lore: Lightning courts its antlers. It stands on the high fells in the worst weather, daring the sky to try.

monsters.name: Runemane
monsters.lore: A guardian left running after its temple fell. The cyan runes still burn with orders no one can rescind.

monsters.name: Blightcur
monsters.lore: Sickness on four legs. It survived what it carries, which is more than those it visits can say.

monsters.name: Dunedelver
monsters.lore: It swims through sand the way fish forget water. Only the jagged back-plates betray the tide beneath.

monsters.name: Winterfang
monsters.lore: Its mane is a crown of ice that never melts. The cold arrives a breath before it does, and stays after.

monsters.name: Ironhide
monsters.lore: Armor that grew instead of being forged. Spears skate off its plates; its tusks do not return the favor.

monsters.name: Gloompard
monsters.lore: Count its violet eyes and you have already lost it. The smoke it trails is the only warning anyone gets.

monsters.name: Amethyrn
monsters.lore: A beast crowned with one great amethyst horn. It headbutts like a landslide and grazes on buried gems.

monsters.name: Mireback
monsters.lore: A bear the swamp claimed and gave back. Mushrooms fruit on its shoulders; its jaw closes like a bog-gate.

monsters.name: Slagfang
monsters.lore: A wolf quenched in the caldera. Magma veins its black hide, and its bite leaves wounds already cauterized.

monsters.name: Basalthowl
monsters.lore: The pack-sire of the volcanic wolves. When it roars, the mountain answers, and the ash begins to fall.

monsters.name: Frostwraith
monsters.lore: Gaunt, winged and starving in the drifts. Its ice-claws leave frost-burned wounds that are slow to close.

monsters.name: Nightmule
monsters.lore: A pack beast gone feral in the dark, white-eyed and stubborn. It charges head-first and will not be reasoned with.

monsters.name: Duskfang
monsters.lore: A shadow-furred hunter out of an older age. It runs down what it wants and ends the argument in one bite.

monsters.name: Diretusk
monsters.lore: A mountain of dark wool and ivory, calm until crowded. One sweep of those tusks clears a road.
